attendance.note: Organiser-reported: 'more than 120,000 attendees in 2026' (MDW About page). 2025: more than 100,000, the largest crowd on record at the time (NGV 2026 media release).

audience.psychographics: Designers, architects, educators, design businesses and the design-curious public; the organiser says MDW engages both professional audiences and the general public through talks, tours, dinners, exhibitions, launches and workshops.

ticket_price.note: Open public program; FAQ says the majority of events are free but may need bookings or have capacity limits. Ticketed events are priced individually.
